policy: Only reviewed phrase-to-widget contracts with confirmed FontObjects are checked. Source digests pin producers; review callers, template inheritance and later font setters before refreshing a digest. Buttons bind all declared font states. Bindings check translated wording, excluding dynamic placeholder values. Tooltips, menus, chat, custom font files, dynamic text and unlisted producers have no coverage claim. Empty bindings record reviewed exclusions, not glyph coverage.

producers.review: Read Text, Row, Refresh, Attach, Open, Toggle and event callbacks, plus Core/Core.lua Refresh and toggle callers. Text explicitly assigns GameFontNormalLarge to the page heading, GameFontDisableSmall to notice/empty, GameFontNormalSmall to column headings, and GameFontHighlight to row.name including the Item %d fallback, GameFontHighlightSmall to Window.total, whose only text is the Turn-ins recorded on this character: %d phrase set in ShowTotal (called from Refresh and Core/Stats.lua on a recorded turn-in), and GameFontHighlightSmall to Window.routeStatus, whose only text is a ROUTE_REASONS phrase set in the route button OnClick. No later font setters occur. Pinned Blizzard client b401e0332adfbf0460d319b06d8ea29279a941f1, Blizzard_SharedXML/Shared/Button/ThreeSliceButtonTemplate.xml: SharedButtonSmallTemplate declares normal/highlight/disabled GameFontNormal/GameFontHighlight/GameFontDisable for route. Tooltip/tab tooltip, chat and UIErrorsFrame messages, user search input, dynamic item/faction names and counts are excluded. AGENTS.md declares no custom font files; no custom font-file assignments occur in this repo.
